title: ERP•AI Launches Proto Agent With $0 Per Seat Business Software
summary:
A new ecosystem from ERP•AI allows businesses to generate custom enterprise tools via a natural language prompt and operate them through an autonomous agent called Proto. The a platform, described as "Headless SaaS," enables the agent to build systems for CRM, inventory, and invoice tracking, and subsequently execute workflows, manage records, and generate reports. To align with this agent-led model, the company abandoned per-user pricing and now charges $0 per seat, billing instead for machine-driven activity.

Usage is managed via prepaid credits available in $5, $20, and $100 packs, and new accounts receive $100 in starting credit valid for one month. A $1 credit covers 4,000 record writes, 2,000 workflow runs, or 2,000 agent executions, while AI processing is billed at the model's base cost plus an 8% fee. Steve Papa and the founding team stated the goal is to move beyond the 25 year industry assumption that humans must be the primary operators of enterprise software.

selectedTweets.text:
AI agents are becoming the main user of company software, with humans approving its actions instead of entering data themselves.
So it should be metered accordingly.

ERP[.]AI has released a platform for business software that charges $0 per seat and bills the machines instead.

Seats, apps, roles, permissions and manual record work in its interface cost nothing, while API-key access, imports, workflows, agents and AI draw down prepaid credits.

Those credits come in one-time $5, $20 and $100 packs, and every new account gets $100 of starting credit that lasts 1 month.

The meter is fine-grained, because $1 buys 4,000 record writes, 2,000 workflow runs or 2,000 agent executions, and AI is billed at the model’s exact cost plus an 8% agent fee.

Most of that metered work comes from Proto, a desktop agent that sets up data, approvals, permissions and dashboards in ERP[.]AI from a plain description of how a business runs.
